focus: Dallas (Uptown, Design District, Oak Cliff, East Dallas, Lake Highlands, Northwest and Far North Dallas), plus mobile notaries based in Garland, Grand Prairie, and Arlington who travel into the city
intro: Bank branches in Dallas usually stop notarizing by late afternoon. This first Dallas page lists mobile notaries whose own websites publish evening, weekend, 24-hour, or hospital and jail service in the city — including three based just outside Dallas in Garland, Grand Prairie, and Arlington, clearly labeled — plus eleven UPS Store locations whose official pages post notary hours until 6:30 PM or later on weekdays, most of them open Sundays too. It is not a complete inventory of the city. Every hour, fee, and service flag comes from the business’s own page and is dated when we last checked it. If we could not verify a detail, we left it out. Call or text to confirm before you go or book.

listings.name: DFW 24/7 Mobile Notary

hours.notes: The site says it answers calls and dispatches notaries any hour, any day, including holidays and weekends. Evening (6–10 PM), late-night (10 PM–6 AM), and weekend/holiday visits carry added fees.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists hospital, rehab, and hospice visits, jail and detention center visits in Dallas, Tarrant, and Collin counties, and visits at DFW Airport and Dallas Love Field. Remote online notarization was not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-20: general mobile notarization $45 base travel fee plus $6 per notarization; single-document signing $50 flat; hospital, rehab, and hospice visits $95 flat (travel, up to 2 documents, and 1 hour of wait); jail and detention center visits $150 flat; airport visits $125 flat. Evening (6–10 PM) adds $35, late night (10 PM–6 AM) adds $65, and weekend/holiday emergency service adds $45.

listings.name: Just Doing Business LLC — Dallas mobile notary
listings.area: Dallas and the DFW metroplex (mobile); office in Arlington

hours.notes: The Dallas page says it dispatches across Dallas 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holiday weekends. In-office appointments at its Arlington office (1000 Ballpark Way, Suite 310) are Monday–Friday 9 AM–5 PM.

listings.visitNotes: The Dallas page lists hospital bedside visits, nursing centers and hospice, and jail visits including Dallas County Jail (Lew Sterrett) and Tarrant County Jail. It also offers Texas remote online notarization by video.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published on the Dallas page we checked.

listings.name: Knox Mobile Notary
listings.area: Dallas, Irving, Garland, Mesquite, Richardson, Grand Prairie, Plano, and Frisco (mobile)

hours.notes: The site says it is available 8 a.m. to 9 p.m., 7 days a week, including Saturdays and Sundays, and to text about times outside those hours.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists visits to hospitals, nursing homes, and assisted-living facilities; the signer must be alert, able to communicate, and have valid ID. Jail visits and online notarization were not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published; the site says you get an up-front quote before the visit.

listings.name: Redlab Mobile Notary
listings.area: Garland-based; in person in Dallas and 13 other DFW cities; online anywhere in Texas

hours.notes: The site lists hours of 7 AM–10 PM, 7 days a week, with same-day appointments and no after-hours surcharge.

listings.visitNotes: The site offers priority dispatch for hospital, hospice, rehab, and nursing-home signings across DFW, and remote online notarization (RON) over video for anyone in Texas. Jail visits were not mentioned on the page we checked. The site says it does not take full loan signing packages.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-20: $10 per signature plus travel at $1.50 per mile ($25 minimum); online notarization $10 per signature plus a $25 RON fee; hospital/bedside priority dispatch $50 plus $10 per signature plus travel; no after-hours, weekend, or holiday surcharge.

listings.name: Garcia's Mobile Notary

hours.notes: The site lists availability 7 days a week, 9:00 AM–9:00 PM, and says emergency, evening, hospital, and weekend appointments may be available outside standard hours.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists bedside notarizations at hospitals, plus nursing home, assisted living, and hospice visits. Jail visits and online notarization were not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-20: $75 travel within 10 miles plus $1.50 per mile beyond; Texas per-signature notary fees at state rates; after-hours appointment +$25; emergency same-day +$50; hospital/nursing home visits from $95; waiting $20 per 15 minutes after a 10-minute grace period; tolls and parking at cost.

listings.name: Grand Prairie Mobile Notary — Dallas
listings.area: Dallas (mobile), from Oak Cliff to Lake Highlands; based in Grand Prairie

hours.notes: Regular hours are not published. The Dallas page offers evenings, weekends, and urgent same-day requests, with an added fee before 8 AM, after 7 PM, and on weekends and holidays.

listings.visitNotes: The Dallas page lists hospital and nursing home visits and jail and detention center visits. Online notarization was not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-20: general mobile notarization $50 (travel within 20 driving miles of Grand Prairie included, 1 signer, +$10 each extra signer); hospital/care facility $85; jail visit $125; loan signing $150; after-hours and weekends +$25. Texas notary fee of $10 for the first signature and $1 for each additional signature.
